# Command reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

A command is the one way to change a project (`Command` → `Transaction` → `Op`). The same command runs from the user interface, from a command log replayed by `ew apply`, from scripts and from the Session API. Each page below gives the command's registry entry, its parameters with types and constraints, and the exit codes of `ew apply`.

36 commands, from the parameter schemas in [`crates/ew-commands/schemas`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/tree/main/crates/ew-commands/schemas). The catalogue of the command registry is [doc 17 §2.1](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#21-command-registry).

| Command | Summary | Cost | Exposure | Stability |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`assembly.attach`](assembly.attach.md) | `assembly.attach` (`AttachChildren`): makes existing devices children of a parent device (doc 03 §7: modules of a valve terminal under its head device, a mounting plate under its enclosure), with their positions (FR-DEV-022: child order is `Device.position`, never the drawing). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`bond.create`](bond.create.md) | `bond.create` (`CreateBond`): declares a bond, a link of two potentials that does not merge them (doc 03 §9.6, doc 08 §3.7; FR-CON-014, the "declare bond" quick fix of EW-POT-001). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`box.black`](box.black.md) | `box.black` (`PlaceBlackBox`, doc 06 §2.7, §3.1): places a black box, a function of kind `black_box` drawn with the black-box symbol and its page geometry. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`cable.create`](cable.create.md) | a cable device with its conductors (doc 03 §12). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`conductor.add`](conductor.add.md) | conductors of an existing cable. Rejected: the device has no cable aspect; a core already used in the cable or twice in the list. Outcome: the first new conductor. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`connection.delete`](connection.delete.md) | removes connections through the delete policies (they leave junction sequences; bonds lose their `via`). A junction left with two or fewer connections is cleaned up by normaliser #8. Every connection must exist. Outcome: none. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`connection.draw`](connection.draw.md) | `connection.draw` (`Connect`, doc 06 §3.5, §4.4): one explicit connection. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`connection.route`](connection.route.md) | replaces a connection's route (FR-CON-007). Connectivity is unchanged. On a page the route must be on the page's connection grid and its ends must meet their CPs (D3, `geometry::require_route`). Outcome: the connection. Coalesce route drags with a key. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`device.create`](device.create.md) | a device without a representation (FR-DEV-001), optionally with its main function. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`device.link`](device.link.md) | `device.link` (`LinkDevices`, doc 11 §4.3 `device.link{from, to, Drives}`): a functional link between two devices, such as a valve that drives a field device (doc 11 §3.3: the PLC overview and the I/O list print the driven device's process tag). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`device.place`](device.place.md) | `device.place` (`PlaceSymbol`, doc 06 §3.3): places a symbol and creates the device and function as the target requires. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`edit.delete`](edit.delete.md) | removes the selected records with everything the delete policies take along (FR-DEV-030), in **one** delete plan for all targets (`TxBuilder::delete_many`): the result does not depend on the order of the targets, a target that another target's cascade removes is planned once, and a target listed twice counts once. Deleting a representation leaves its function unplaced (an IP function goes with it); deleting a device removes its functions, their representations and connections. A target that does not exist at the start is `NotFound`; a forbid link (a strip with terminals, a referenced structure node) rejects the whole command (`ModelError::Referenced`). Cost: `Bulk` when the plan removes or changes more than 500 records (D4; the plan is computed once by `cost`). Outcome: none. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`external_ref.create`](external_ref.create.md) | `external_ref.create` (`CreateExternalRef`): a point outside the project that an interruption point or a structure box can name (doc 03 §6, FR-XRF-011): a device, and optionally its connection, at a location node, optionally in another project ("JE-N1000-03", connection "L", at +J-E-206). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`fields.set`](fields.set.md) | `fields.set` (`SetFields`): sets one field on one or more records of one kind. | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`ip.continue`](ip.continue.md) | the partner of an interruption point on another page (FR-XRF-014). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`ip.place`](ip.place.md) | an interruption point (FR-XRF-006 … FR-XRF-014, doc 03 §10): the IP function and its one representation in one transaction (EW-INV-013). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`junction.edit`](junction.edit.md) | style, wiring and sequence of a junction (FR-CON-005, doc 06 §3.5). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`library.embed`](library.embed.md) | `library.embed` (`EmbedLibraryCopies`): embeds library items into the project, each as a copy that carries its lineage `{library_id, item_id, version, sha256}` (doc 05 §13.2), such as the frame form without grid that generated section dividers and report pages need (doc 20 §20.2 step 4). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`numbering.renumber`](numbering.renumber.md) | `numbering.renumber` (`RenumberDevices`): renumbers device counters under the page-based scheme. | bulk | edit | preview |
| [`page.create`](page.create.md) | a new drawn page (FR-PAG-005, doc 06 §5.6). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`page.delete`](page.delete.md) | removes pages with everything they own (FR-PAG-025, doc 06 §3.4). | bulk | edit | preview |
| [`page.renumber`](page.renumber.md) | renumbers folio numbers (FR-PAG-007). References are by ID, so every xref, tag and TOC row follows without further ops. | bulk | edit | preview |
| [`plc.bind_channel`](plc.bind_channel.md) | `plc.bind_channel` (`BindChannel`, doc 10 §3.3, §3.9 `plc.bind_channel{channel, endpoint}`): binds a channel to its signal CP, rebinds it, or unbinds it (FR-PLC-020). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`plc.config_project.create`](plc.config_project.create.md) | `plc.config_project.create` (`CreatePlcConfigProject`): a configuration project, the target PLC-software project that scopes address and symbol uniqueness (doc 10 §2.2, FR-PLC-002). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`potential.define`](potential.define.md) | names and types a potential at a CP or a junction (FR-CON-010). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`project.settings.set`](project.settings.set.md) | `project.settings.set` (`SetProjectSettings`): sets one member of the project settings. | bulk | edit | preview |
| [`project.supply.set`](project.supply.set.md) | `project.supply.set` (`SetProjectSupply`): sets one member of the project's supply, such as its origin, the external reference the supply comes from ("J-E-206-L", doc 20 §4.2). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`rep.move`](rep.move.md) | moves representations by a delta, optionally to another page (doc 06 §3.4). Moves never change connectivity (FR-CON-004). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`rep.set_anchor_policy`](rep.set_anchor_policy.md) | sets the cross-reference anchor policy of representations (FR-SYM-010; the quick fix of MF-13, doc 07 §3.6). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`rep.transform`](rep.transform.md) | rotates, mirrors or changes the variant of representations about their insertion point (doc 06 §3.4). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`report_block.create`](report_block.create.md) | a report block (doc 03 §6, doc 09 §2.2). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`section.create`](section.create.md) | a folio range with a title (doc 03 §6, FR-PAG-008). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`structure.create_node`](structure.create_node.md) | one identifier in one aspect tree (doc 03 §5, FR-PRJ-017). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`terminal.add`](terminal.add.md) | terminals of a strip; a terminal is a device with the terminal aspect (doc 03 §11). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`terminal.designate`](terminal.designate.md) | sets the designations of one or more terminals in one transaction (doc 03 §11). | interactive | edit | preview |
| [`valve.add`](valve.add.md) | `valve.add` (`AddValve`, doc 11 §4.3 `valve.add{module, position?, part}`): adds a valve child to a module (sub-base) of a valve terminal. | interactive | edit | preview |
